name: ROBERTS, Malcolm Ieuan

headline.note: Official and first-person sources establish a long private-sector mining and consulting career, but the available year-only chronology contains overlaps and does not establish full-time status, exact boundaries, leave or every employing entity. Governance, unpaid advocacy and elected office are excluded, so no precise public/private full-time total is calculated.

career_spells.evidence_note: The Parliamentary Handbook lists vineyard labour in 1973 but does not identify the employer, duration, hours or employment basis.
career_spells.counting_note: A year label alone does not establish a countable full-time interval.

career_spells.evidence_note: Roberts's executive CV gives 1973-1976 for his University of Queensland engineering degree; his party biography and the Parliamentary Handbook corroborate the qualification.

career_spells.employer: Five Australian coal mines not individually identified
career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography and Roberts's CV give 1977-1979; the CV says five mines in four Australian regions, while party and Senate accounts describe about three years, mainly underground, including the Hunter and Queensland. Employers, mine-by-mine dates, hours and leave are unpublished.
career_spells.counting_note: Substantive mining work is supported, but the employers, ownership and full-time intervals are not sufficiently resolved.

career_spells.employer: Peabody Coal Company and Consolidation Coal Company
career_spells.evidence_note: Roberts's CV names both US coal companies and gives 1979-1981; the Parliamentary Handbook gives the broader mining-engineer interval 1979-1983. The CV does not split time between the employers or supply exact dates, hours or leave.
career_spells.counting_note: Private employment is supported, but employer-specific and full-time boundaries remain unresolved.

career_spells.role: Senior mining engineer and shift undermanager, Liddell Mine
career_spells.evidence_note: The CV gives the employer, Liddell site, roles and 1982-1984. The official biography gives mining engineer through 1983 and mine manager from 1983, creating an unresolved year-level transition.
career_spells.counting_note: Exact role boundaries, hours and leave are unavailable.

career_spells.role: Mine manager, including Moonee Mine, Wallarah coal preparation plant and shiploader, and West Wallsend Mine
career_spells.evidence_note: The CV groups mine-management responsibility under Coal & Allied across 1982-1988, while the official biography labels him a mine manager from 1983-1988. Roberts's Senate account corroborates management of Hunter Valley coal mines. Site-by-site appointment dates and overlap with the Liddell engineering role are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: The overlapping year-only role chronology cannot support a precise non-duplicated full-time duration.

career_spells.employer: University of Chicago Booth School of Business
career_spells.evidence_note: Roberts's CV gives 1988-1990 for the MBA; the Parliamentary Handbook corroborates the qualification.

career_spells.employer: Atlantic Richfield Company, managing partner of the Gordonstone Joint Venture
career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography gives general manager 1990-1993. Roberts's CV identifies Atlantic Richfield, Gordonstone, Brisbane and Emerald and describes construction, commissioning and operation of the underground project.
career_spells.counting_note: The role and private employer are well supported, but year-only dates, full-time status, leave and exact boundaries remain unpublished.

career_spells.employer: Conscious Pty Ltd, trading as Catalyst For Corporate Performance
career_spells.role: Co-founder, contract operations leader and management consultant
career_spells.evidence_note: Roberts's CV says he co-founded the company in 1994 and lists contract management and advisory clients in Australia, New Zealand, India and the United States. The undated CV labels the role present, but does not give client-by-client dates, workload, gaps, remuneration, leave or a cessation date before parliamentary service.
career_spells.counting_note: Business ownership and consulting activity are supported, but a continuous substantive full-time interval cannot be assumed.

career_spells.employer: Montessori School Limited / Brisbane Montessori School
career_spells.role: Chairman of the board and non-executive director
career_spells.evidence_note: The Parliamentary Handbook and Roberts's CV give the 1999-2003 chairmanship; the CV calls it a non-executive directorship. Remuneration and time commitment are not stated.
Roberts's CV gives 2000-2008 for service on the US global advisory board and describes strategy and governance advice; remuneration and workload are not stated.

The official biography records investigation of climate claims from 2008. Roberts's CV identifies project leadership from 2011 and explicitly says he refused salary; the end is bounded by first entry to Parliament, but exact cessation and workload are unresolved.
Official parliamentary records show the 2016 election and the High Court ruling of 27 October 2017 that the election was void and Roberts was ineligible from 2 July 2016.
Official parliamentary records show election in 2019 and re-election in 2025.

research_notes: Identify the 1973 vineyard employer and each of the five 1977-1979 coal mines, with ownership, appointment/cessation, hours and leave.
Split the Peabody and Consolidation Coal engineering periods and reconcile the official 1979-1983 interval with the CV's 1979-1981 US employment and 1982 Coal & Allied start.
Resolve Coal & Allied site-by-site engineering, undermanager and mine-manager boundaries, full-time status, leave and the 1983 transition stated by the Parliamentary Handbook.
Obtain Atlantic Richfield/Gordonstone exact appointment and cessation dates, employment basis, hours and leave.

Obtain Conscious Pty Ltd corporate history and client-by-client paid engagement dates, workload and gaps; do not treat company ownership or an undated 'present' CV label as continuous full-time employment.
Confirm Montessori governance remuneration and workload; these roles remain excluded regardless.
Resolve post-2008 paid consulting versus unpaid climate advocacy and any work between the 2017 disqualification and 2019 Senate return.
